user.description: Choose the LYWSD02 clock to keep on time.

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This clock is already being set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No LYWSD02 clock found. Bring it closer to your Bluetooth adapter or proxy, then try again.

init.title: Automatic sync
init.description: When should Home Assistant set the clock? Daylight saving changes are always corrected within the hour, and the Sync clock button works at any time. The temperature unit, time format and time correction are on the device page.

data_description.time: A quiet moment, such as the night, works best.

data_description.day: From 1 to 28, so that every month has this day.

cron.title: Custom schedule
cron.description: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. Examples: `0 4 * * *` every day at 04:00, `30 3 * * 1` every Monday at 03:30, `0 */6 * * *` every 6 hours.

error.invalid_cron: This cron expression is not valid.
error.too_frequent: Leave at least one hour between two syncs to save the battery.

not_in_range.message: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy heard {name} during the search. It will be synchronized as soon as it is heard again.

passive_only.message: {name} is only heard by Bluetooth proxies that cannot connect. Enable connections on a proxy near the clock, or bring a Bluetooth adapter closer.

no_connectable_adapter.message: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy of Home Assistant can connect to {name}.

passive_only.title: {name} is only heard by passive Bluetooth proxies
passive_only.description:
Home Assistant hears {name}, but only through Bluetooth proxies that cannot connect to devices, so it cannot set the clock.

Do one of these:
- On an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy near the clock, enable connections with `active: true` under `bluetooth_proxy:`, then install the update.
- Or bring a Bluetooth adapter of Home Assistant closer to the clock.

The clock is synchronized as soon as it can be reached, and this message disappears.

no_connectable_adapter.title: No Bluetooth adapter can connect to {name}
no_connectable_adapter.description:
Home Assistant has no Bluetooth adapter or proxy that can connect to devices, so it cannot set the clock of {name}. Passive proxies and Shelly devices only listen.

Add a Bluetooth adapter to Home Assistant, or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with `active: true` under `bluetooth_proxy:`. The clock is synchronized as soon as it can be reached, and this message disappears.
